inspection.responsive_result: At 320 and 360 CSS px, document scrollWidth equals clientWidth in both themes; component cards stack in order, SVG and raster figures scale proportionally, and no element crosses the viewport boundary.

source_and_computation_separation.mit_context: Both raster captions explicitly identify MIT perching context as a different vehicle or campaign and deny any X8 numerical role.
